verdict.rationale: Galileo documents log-based alerts that fire when conditions are met, such as cost rising above expectations or hallucination rates exceeding a threshold. That amounts to rules triggering a notification on events. The evidence stops at alerting: it does not show rules triggering other automated actions. Missing for 10: configurable actions beyond alerts (e.g. webhooks, auto-remediation, workflow triggers), detail on rule definition and condition syntax, notification channels, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
